name: Hinagata Kobato
source:
Occupation: Young idol
Activities: Cooking
Favorite things: Plushies, western music
Hobbies: Collecting plushies, Character impersonation
Special skills: Cooking, sewing
Problem areas: Paparazzi
A girl who became an idol by her parent’s suggestion in order to overcome her fear of crowds. 
Kobato has a quiet and gentle personality, but is ultimately withdrawn 
She loves plushies, especially her Cthulhu doll “Rapu”. 
Kobato eventually gets inspired by the protagonist’s willpower, and is able to stand up for herself more because of him.
Her measurements grow up to 87(I)-46-82
